rules.name: continuous_cross_domain_scan
rules.summary: Relevant domain/Z-stack agents cross-reference new evidence automatically; synthesis remains evidence-labelled.

rules.name: known_unknown_registration
rules.summary: Unresolved required variables receive stable IDs, dependencies, resolution methods and falsifiable next steps.

rules.name: autonomous_research_proposal
rules.summary: New patterns/unknowns generate agent-reviewed research proposals with completed-task comparison, expected information gain and preliminary H/M/L priority.

rules.name: information_yield_first
rules.summary: Prefer material knowledge/operational improvement and dependency unlock over micro-refinement, subject to safety/acceptance exceptions.

rules.name: raw_test_preservation
rules.summary: Write immutable/raw test record before synthesis; corrections append and never silently replace source evidence.

rules.name: outcome_classification
rules.summary: Distinguish physical null/negative/outlier/inconclusive from INVALID_HARNESS, INVALID_INPUT and MODEL_LIMITATION.

rules.name: sweep_synthesis
rules.summary: Completed bounded sweeps produce hypothesis/null/expectation/observed/outlier/limits/reasoning/next-step synthesis referencing all underlying test IDs.

rules.name: technology_centric_twin
rules.summary: One canonical twin/workbook per technology family; configurations/tests are versioned rows/receipts and may carry asset/test IDs without creating parallel masters.

rules.name: cross_domain_equation_abstraction
rules.summary: Candidate common equations require explicit variable/unit/domain/invariant mappings and falsifiable predictions; analogy alone is insufficient.

rules.name: evidence_triggered_reanalysis
rules.summary: Material new evidence automatically identifies downstream conclusions/tasks for reanalysis while retaining supersession lineage.

rules.name: research_engineering_boundary
rules.summary: Novel R&D layers remain separate from certified/conventional baseline and cannot bypass physical, professional or regulatory validation.

rules.name: partner_proposal_firewall
rules.summary: Named external organisations remain proposed/earmarked/candidate until attributable agreements or authority evidence exist.

owner_control: Owner may override task priority, depth and order; provenance and raw evidence remain immutable/append-only.
no_go: Do not promote agent inference to fact without evidence.
Do not classify code/test-harness failure as physical null.
Do not let novelty override safety/compliance gates.
